completeness_check.method: Deck-count arithmetic from the Codex ledger (TURN_LEDGER.json) of 200654.
completeness_check.arithmetic: Opening hand 5 (Research, Zigzagoon, Needle, Poke Ball, Poke Ball) + 7 turn draws on his turns 2/4/6/8/10/12/14 (Zweilous, Lillie, Hydreigon, Research, Deino, Obstagoon, Piers) + 2 Poke Ball finds (Deino, Zigzagoon) + 4 Research draws (Obstagoon, Needle; Rare Candy, Rare Candy) = 18 cards drawn, all identified. The last 2 cards of the 20 were never drawn and never shown.
completeness_check.pooled_cross_check: Pooled lower bounds over the eight Sep 26-28 recordings: Zigzagoon 2, Linoone 2, Obstagoon 2, Deino 2, Zweilous 1, Hydreigon 1, Needle 2, Poke Ball 2, Research 2, Rare Candy 2, Lillie 1, Piers 1 = exactly 20, with the Basic count pinned at four by the failed Poke Ball in 20260927_212437. One constant list explains every recording, apart from the unresolved Rainbow Cave line.

caveats: Approximate: the exact historical 20-card list was never stored (DECK_USED exact_list_status unavailable_historical_snapshot; LADDER_LOG_CAPTURE says the log holds visible cores only). 18 of 20 slots are directly seen in this game; the 2 inferred slots rest on other recordings of the deck 2 days earlier and 1 day earlier, assuming he did not change the list between Sep 26 and Sep 28.

Rainbow Cave: the 20260926_213750 review says the player played Rainbow Cave on turn 2 (sampled at 5 s spacing, ownership not certified; the opponent was an Entei ex deck, and Rainbow Cave was clearly the opponents' in 20260927_205926 and 20260927_212437). Taken as the opponent's, because with Rainbow Cave the pooled count would be 21 cards. In a Darkness-only Energy Zone it would be close to a dead card, so if it were his the effect would be small; if it replaced one Linoone, one inferred slot would change.

The two undrawn cards are not Basic Pokemon (a failed Poke Ball in 20260927_212437 shows exactly four Basics in the deck), so Bombirdier and Mega Absol ex from the repo Hydreigon list cannot be in this list; Copycat, Cyrus, Sabrina and Lucky Ice Pop were never shown on his side in any of the eight recordings (the Ice Pop plays in 200654 are the opponent's, as DECK_USED notes).

Hydreigon and Zweilous are counted once (never two at once); the list therefore has a 2-1-1 Deino line with 2 Rare Candy. A second Hydreigon or Zweilous is possible only if the list changed between recordings.

Printings: alternate arts (gold, full art, rainbow border) are the same playable card. Ids are the first printing from card_ids.py with matching stats (Hydreigon B1 157 over B1 245, Obstagoon B2 100 over B2 176), and the repo's usual ids for Poke Ball (P-A 005), Professor's Research (P-A 007), Rare Candy (A3 144) and Lillie (A3 155). Linoone B2 099 (Rear Kick 40) is the printing named in the reviews, not B4 096 (Night Slash 30).
Energy type is Darkness (his Energy Zone gave Darkness in the recording; Ladder Log saves the game under 'custom Hydreigon / Galarian Obstagoon, Darkness Energy').

Game mode (ladder vs Auto) is classified ladder_presumed; independent acceptance is accepted_with_recording_limits. This does not affect the card list. The reconstruction is not to be used for any verdict on who played better.

What would change the picture: a stored deck code or list screenshot for Sep 28; footage showing Rainbow Cave or another non-Linoone card on his side; or any recording showing Hydreigon or Zweilous twice at once. None of these would change the 18 seen cards.
